title.value: Master of Business Administration Full Time Programme
title.evidence_quote: Master of business administration full time programme

institution.name: UCT Graduate School of Business, University of Cape Town

description_short: The UCT Graduate School of Business is accepting applications for its one-year, face-to-face full-time MBA in Cape Town, starting 11 August 2027. The listed application period runs from 1 September 2026 to 31 May 2027.
status_evidence: Official UCT GSB full-time MBA page (search results): application period 1 September 2026 - 31 May 2027, programme start 11 August 2027
Programme-format page lists rounds with submissions due 15 April, 15 May and 30 June 2027, which conflicts with the 31 May end date; capped at OPEN_LIKELY
uncertainties: Evidence seen through web-search results of the official page; the page itself could not be fetched from this environment

Source list (fellowshipsguide.com / mlscientist.com / vacancyedu.com) unreachable from this environment (egress proxy refused the connection); opportunity found by web search for the category this source covers, then confirmed on the official domain
Evidence quotes are the wording shown in search results
Deadline conflict on the official site: overview page says 31 May 2027, programme-format page lists a final round on 30 June 2027; the earlier 31 May date is recorded
Self-funded degree programme (programme fee reported as R367 000), not a scholarship; fee not recorded as compensation
